system.name: ANT_ALMOHANDES
system.purpose: Master validation and quality-gate schema for residential architectural generation, ensuring no final output is delivered unless critical requirements, spatial relations, geometry, vertical consistency, code-traceability, and cross-output consistency pass validation.

entity_identity.rule: Every validation run must identify the exact project revision and geometry source being tested.

traceability.rule: Every major architectural element must be traceable to the validated geometry or a documented requirement.

test_suite.name: INPUT_COMPLETENESS
test_suite.objective: Verify that all information required for the requested operation is present or explicitly marked as an assumption.
test_suite.pass_condition: No unresolved critical input is silently invented.

test_suite.name: REQUIRED_SPACE_COMPLETENESS
test_suite.objective: Ensure every mandatory client space exists with the correct identity and function.
test_suite.pass_condition: 100 percent of mandatory spaces are present and correctly classified.

test_suite.name: SPACE_IDENTITY_INTEGRITY
test_suite.objective: Prevent one requested room from being silently replaced by another function.
test_suite.pass_condition: No unauthorized functional replacement detected.

test_suite.name: RELATION_GRAPH_INTEGRITY
test_suite.objective: Verify that all mandatory spatial relations are represented and satisfied.
test_suite.pass_condition: Every critical relation passes.

test_suite.name: MEN_GUEST_BATHROOM_CRITICAL_LOCK
test_suite.objective: Prevent the known men's guest bathroom failure.
test_suite.path_rule: men_guest_entrance -> men_guest_council -> men_guest_bathroom must not traverse FAMILY or PRIVATE zones.
test_suite.pass_condition: All required relations and path restrictions pass.

test_suite.name: PRIVACY_PATH_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Prevent public and guest circulation from violating family or private privacy.
test_suite.pass_condition: No forbidden privacy-zone crossing exists.

test_suite.name: DOOR_DESTINATION_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Ensure every door connects the correct pair of spaces and preserves the intended access type.
test_suite.pass_condition: All critical doors resolve to the intended destination.

test_suite.name: CIRCULATION_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Ensure primary circulation remains usable and unobstructed.
test_suite.pass_condition: All required circulation paths exist without forbidden crossings or functional obstruction.

test_suite.name: STAIR_CONTINUITY
test_suite.objective: Ensure stairs remain geometrically and functionally continuous across floors.
test_suite.pass_condition: The vertical circulation system is continuous and traceable.

test_suite.name: MULTI_FLOOR_GLOBAL_CONSISTENCY
test_suite.objective: Ensure all floors belong to one building geometry rather than independently generated layouts.
test_suite.pass_condition: All floors remain consistent with the global building model.

test_suite.name: WINDOW_SOURCE_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Prevent invented windows in elevations or renders.
test_suite.pass_condition: No unsourced window exists.

test_suite.name: BALCONY_SOURCE_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Prevent invented balconies and projections.
test_suite.pass_condition: Every balcony or projection is traceable.

test_suite.name: FOUR_ELEVATION_GEOMETRY_MATCH
test_suite.objective: Ensure north, south, east, and west elevations represent the exact same validated building.
test_suite.pass_condition: All four elevations are consistent with validated geometry.

test_suite.name: SECTION_GEOMETRY_MATCH
test_suite.objective: Ensure sections do not contradict plans or building geometry.
test_suite.pass_condition: No contradiction between section and source geometry.

test_suite.name: 3D_GEOMETRY_MATCH
test_suite.objective: Ensure the 3D model is a faithful representation of validated geometry.
test_suite.pass_condition: 3D geometry contains no unauthorized architectural drift.

test_suite.name: OUTPUT_CROSS_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Verify that all outputs describe one and only one building.
test_suite.pass_condition: No material cross-output inconsistency exists.

test_suite.name: CODE_TRACEABILITY
test_suite.objective: Ensure any code-based design decision is traceable to a documented source and edition.
test_suite.pass_condition: No invented code rule is presented as authoritative.

test_suite.name: FURNITURE_FUNCTIONALITY_CHECK
test_suite.objective: Use furniture as a secondary usability test without allowing it to hide geometry errors.
test_suite.pass_condition: Major room functions remain usable.

test_suite.name: GARAGE_ACCESS_VALIDATION
test_suite.objective: Ensure vehicle access and house entry relationships are preserved.
test_suite.pass_condition: Garage system is functionally connected and privacy-safe.

test_suite.name: ASSUMPTION_AUDIT
test_suite.objective: Ensure assumptions are visible and not confused with client requirements or official code requirements.
test_suite.pass_condition: All assumptions are explicitly classified.

test_suite.name: OUTPUT_DRIFT_CHECK
test_suite.objective: Detect unintended geometric or functional changes between revisions and outputs.
test_suite.pass_condition: Every material change has a documented cause.

test_suite.name: FINAL_CRITICAL_FAILURE_SCAN
test_suite.objective: Perform one final blocking scan immediately before final delivery.
test_suite.pass_condition: All critical scans pass.

rules.condition: any high test FAIL and unresolved
all mandatory tests PASS and no critical failures
validated output plus final acceptance approval

principles: Fix the source, not only the visible symptom.
Rebuild dependent outputs after source geometry changes.
Never preserve an attractive but invalid output just because it looks better.
After every critical fix, rerun all affected tests.
After any geometry revision, rerun cross-output validation.

11_MASTER_VALIDATION_SCHEMA.json.final_rule: A design is not accepted because it looks correct. It is accepted only when its requirements, relationships, geometry, privacy, vertical consistency, traceability, and outputs pass the applicable validation gates.

system.name: ANT_ALMOHANDES_MASTER_DECISION_ENGINE
system.purpose: Deterministic architectural decision, conflict-resolution, repair, scoring and pre-delivery control engine
system.operating_principle: Never select the prettiest solution first; select the highest-confidence valid solution that satisfies requirements, relations, privacy, circulation, vertical consistency, constructability and traceability.

decision_hierarchy.rule: A lower-priority criterion must never repair or justify a violation of a higher-priority criterion.

must_always_hold.statement: Every required space must exist with the requested function unless explicitly changed by the client.
Male guest circulation must not require passage through family or private zones.
All floors belong to one global building model and share coherent vertical relations.
Every elevation element must be traceable to validated geometry.
No invented door, window, balcony, room, entrance or massing element may enter a final output.
No final output may be delivered while a critical validation failure remains open.

steps.name: NORMALIZE_INPUT
steps.purpose: Convert client language, sketches and source files into normalized requirements without silently changing intent.

steps.name: LOCK_REQUIREMENTS
steps.purpose: Separate hard requirements, preferences, optional items and unknowns.

steps.name: BUILD_PROGRAM
steps.purpose: Create the required space program with stable IDs and functional ownership.

steps.name: BUILD_RELATION_GRAPH
steps.purpose: Translate functional relationships into machine-checkable constraints.

steps.name: BUILD_ACCESS_GRAPH
steps.purpose: Model guest, family, service and vehicle paths and forbidden zones.

steps.name: BUILD_GLOBAL_GEOMETRY
steps.purpose: Construct one building model before deriving floors and outputs.

steps.name: GENERATE_CANDIDATES
steps.purpose: Create one or more spatial candidates without weakening hard invariants.

steps.name: HARD_FILTER
steps.purpose: Immediately eliminate candidates with critical violations.

steps.name: SCORE_SURVIVORS
steps.purpose: Rank valid candidates by functional and quality criteria.

steps.name: REPAIR
steps.purpose: Repair the root causes of non-critical defects before final selection.

steps.name: REVALIDATE
steps.purpose: Run the master validation protocol after every geometry-changing repair.

steps.name: DERIVE_OUTPUTS
steps.purpose: Generate plans, elevations, sections, 3D and documents only from validated geometry.

steps.name: CROSS_VALIDATE_OUTPUTS
steps.purpose: Verify all outputs represent the same building.

steps.name: FINAL_GATE
steps.purpose: Permit FINAL only when no blocking condition remains.

candidate_scoring.purpose: Rank only candidates that pass all hard invariants.

algorithm: Mark each item as hard, critical, preferred, optional or unknown.
Preserve all hard and critical constraints.
Relax only lower-priority preferences when necessary.
If no valid alternative exists, return CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED rather than silently violating a rule.

repair_engine.root_cause_rule: Always repair the earliest layer that caused the failure.

path_test.pass_condition: A valid path exists without traversing forbidden zones.

geometry_integrity_engine.source_rule: No downstream output may invent geometry absent from VALIDATED_GEOMETRY.

rules: Every dependent output is marked stale after its source changes.
Validation results belong to a specific revision.
Rollback must restore the matching geometry and validation state.

failure_memory.pre_generation_action: Load relevant failure patterns and add prevention checks before candidate generation.
failure_memory.post_generation_action: Search the result for known failure signatures before final acceptance.
failure_memory.learning_rule: A repeated failure must trigger a stronger upstream constraint or validation rule, not merely another visual correction.

decision_trace.purpose: Make every major architectural decision auditable and reproducible.

execution_pseudocode: FOR each candidate: RUN hard invariant checks
IF failures exist: IDENTIFY root cause -> REPAIR -> UPDATE geometry -> REVALIDATE
IF any output mismatch: MARK stale -> regenerate from geometry -> revalidate

response_control.when_internal_processing_is_possible: Perform the decision process internally and expose only the useful engineering result unless the user asks for the reasoning record.
response_control.when_user_requests_validation: Return status, blocking failures, affected elements, root causes and required corrections.
response_control.when_user_requests_generation: Generate only from the latest validated source and preserve all locked constraints.
response_control.when_user_requests_prompt: Encode the same hard constraints and negative constraints into the prompt without weakening them.
response_control.when_user_requests_json: Return schema-valid structured data with stable IDs and explicit status fields.

15_MASTER_CANDIDATE_GENERATION_OPTIMIZAT.purpose: توليد عدة حلول تخطيطية مرشحة، استبعاد الحلول المخالفة، تحسين الحلول المقبولة، ثم اختيار الحل الأفضل وفق قيود المشروع وأولويات أنت المهندس.
15_MASTER_CANDIDATE_GENERATION_OPTIMIZAT.core_principle: GENERATE MULTIPLE VALID CANDIDATES -> HARD FILTER -> SCORE -> REPAIR -> REVALIDATE -> SELECT

scoring.hard_constraint_rule: A candidate with any unresolved CRITICAL failure receives score=null and cannot be selected.

space_efficiency.goal: maximize useful program area without sacrificing critical relationships or circulation.

candidate_comparison.selection_rule: select highest scoring eligible candidate after Pareto and tie-break analysis

diversity_control.rule: discard candidate if structural and spatial signature is too similar to an already retained candidate unless it scores materially better.

uncertainty_management.rule: unverified code claims are not treated as scoring penalties only; they are validation blockers when presented as verified requirements.

output_contract.source_rule: all derived outputs must reference selected VALIDATED_GEOMETRY

decision_log.purpose: make candidate selection auditable and reproducible

acceptance_gate.final_rule: THE BEST CANDIDATE IS THE BEST VALIDATED CANDIDATE, NOT THE PRETTIEST CANDIDATE.

15_MASTER_CANDIDATE_GENERATION_OPTIMIZAT.final_operating_principle: GENERATE BROADLY, FILTER STRICTLY, OPTIMIZE SCIENTIFICALLY, VALIDATE REPEATEDLY, DELIVER ONLY THE BEST VALIDATED GEOMETRY.
